headline: Markets closed for weekend; IndusInd Bank terminates Sumant Kathpalia while CBIC proposes draft GST changes.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: CBIC proposed draft GST changes to shield genuine buyers from Input Tax Credit losses.
RBI Chief stated that small business loans can deliver 100 times more economic impact.
IndusInd Bank terminated Sumant Kathpalia's services and invoked clawback provisions.
Gokul raised milk prices by up to ₹6 per litre, drawing reactions from dairy farmers.
whatHappening: IndusInd Bank took strict action against former leadership by terminating services and enforcing clawback clauses.
Tax authorities proposed GST rule updates to safeguard honest taxpayers from ITC loss.
The RBI Governor emphasized the critical role of credit accessibility for small enterprises.
Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, 23 November.
summary:
Markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 23 November.
IndusInd Bank made headlines after terminating Sumant Kathpalia's services and invoking clawback provisions.
Macro updates include CBIC's proposed GST rule updates for ITC protection and RBI chief's remarks on small business loans.
